answer: Reviewers post a 150 POA stake before seeing a batch. Spot checks re-run one answer in twenty; a wrong score forfeits stake and seat. The kernel is uptime: rewards unlock only after 14 continuous days of answering, then vest over 30 against future work. A bridge of accounts that answers once and vanishes earns nothing. Holding 1,000 identities to the zenith of full vesting costs 1,000 stakes and 44 days of daily work.
